verdict.rationale: Pilot's docs reference bookkeeping automation adjacent capabilities (keeping QuickBooks data, payroll administration, real-time expense tracking) but there is no explicit evidence of connecting banking, payments, and payroll systems so that data flows automatically into the ledger — no bank-feed integration, Plaid/Stripe/Gusto connections, or API mentioned, and probes show no public API/integration docs. Missing for 10: explicit list of supported bank/payment/payroll integrations, technical detail on how data syncs automatically, and any hands-on confirmation of automated feeds beyond human bookkeeper processes.
